newsitem.title: USA: Phillips sees $80 mln added to Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Phillips sees $80 mln added to Q2 net.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said on Wednesday it will report an additional $80 million in net income for the second quarter of 1997 after resolving all its outstanding issues with the U.S. Internal Revenue Service.
Phillips said in a news release it expects to receive $102 million in cash refunds from the IRS within 30 days.

The company said the refunds relate mostly to its 70-percent interest in a liquified natural gas facility (LNG) in Kenai, Alaska. The plant produces 1 million tons of LNG a year and sells the output to two utility companies in Japan.
